Hello,

my datas are in a dataframe (t2011), i want to graph (like
yersteday !!) a scatterplot with x axe on a var "fin" and y axe with
another var "attente" (a difftime)

I do :

> g <- ggplot(t2011, aes(fin, attente))
> g + geom_point()
Error in if (length(range) == 1 || diff(range) == 0) { :
missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed

I think a it's a very simple pb but i can't find myself !

Can anybody help me ??

Thank you.
